explainer_content.short_definition: A polished adult pop-rock road of piano ballads, gentle band grooves, warm studio craft, and AM/FM songs built for lasting familiarity.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Soft rock and AM Gold gather the gentler side of the 1970s pop-rock mainstream: Elton John, Billy Joel, Fleetwood Mac, James Taylor, Carole King, America, and related artists. The sound can be intimate or huge, but it usually avoids hard-rock attack.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It gave adult feeling a central place in rock-era radio: breakups, memory, work, home, longing, and self-reflection could become mass singalong material.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The arrangement smooths the edges without erasing songcraft. Piano, acoustic guitar, close drums, and warm backing vocals usually matter more than riffs.
what_to_listen_for: Piano or acoustic guitar carrying the harmony
A lead vocal mixed close and clear
Soft drum grooves and warm backing vocals
A chorus built for recognition rather than shock
